name: AUCorePractitionerMinimal
title: AU Core Practitioner (minimal, hand-authored reproduction — see BUILD_LOG/fhir-gateway.md)
publisher: ReferralPlatform — NOT the official HL7 Australia AU Core IG
description: Minimal reproduction of AU Core Practitioner's key constraints (an HPI-I identifier and a name are required). Not currently applied to any resource this gateway generates by default (referring/receiving practitioners are carried as References with display text + identifier on the ServiceRequest, not as standalone Practitioner resources, since the gateway has no practitioner directory of its own) — included for completeness and for a future standalone Practitioner resource export. Same hand-authored-reproduction caveat as au-core-patient.json.

element.definition: At least one identifier — in a real deployment this is the practitioner's HPI-I (system http://ns.electronichealth.net.au/id/hi/hpii/1.0).
